title: Phase 73 publishes registered analysis execution and result-adjudication controls
summary: Thirty-two inactive execution dockets, eight empty deviation registers, eight inactive result-adjudication dockets, and eight empty correction-withdrawal registers now expose the decision path between a registered design and a bounded public result. All execution, result, review, receipt, correction, and withdrawal fields remain empty.
evidence_note: This release contains empty execution, deviation, adjudication, and correction contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain a registered design receipt, frozen input, code run, execution log, output, unblinded result, deviation, robustness finding, falsification result, replication, effect estimate, claim, correction, withdrawal, reviewer decision, or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds two Published briefings, one Published dependency map, one searchable registry with forty detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, cohort, stage, panel, claim, design, and result states unchanged.
